name: TanStack Query
summary: Async state management library for fetching, caching, synchronizing and updating server state in TypeScript and JavaScript apps.
description: Protocol-agnostic data fetching (REST, GraphQL, promises) with caching, refetching, pagination and infinite scroll, mutations, dependent queries and background updates. Prefetching, cancellation and React Suspense support are built in, with adapters for React, Solid, Svelte and Vue as part of the wider TanStack ecosystem.
contains: caching, refetching, pagination and infinite scroll
mutations, dependent queries and background updates
prefetching, cancellation and React Suspense support
adapters for React, Solid, Svelte and Vue
